Your godparent

Choosing a godparent

Choosing a godparent, or sponsor, is an important part of preparing to enter the Orthodox Church. Your godparent is not simply someone who stands beside you during your Baptism or Chrismation. This person is entering into an ongoing spiritual relationship with you.
